title: Independent reading: Ephesians 3:14–21
subtitle: Read prayer, purpose, and doxology as one coherent unit.
overview: Ephesians 3:14–21 develops a prayer through purpose clauses, infinitives, participles, and a concluding doxology. Map the prayer request before translating its modifiers.
The doxology is structurally connected to the prayer. Track the relative description of God’s power and the final ascription.

items.grc: διὰ τοῦτο κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.
items.en: For this reason I bow my knees before the Father.

items.grc: τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑπὲρ πάντα ποιῆσαι ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ.
items.en: Now to the one able to do far beyond all things.
